itens.trecho: Um bom filme de stop-motion. A quinta da Sra. Tweedy produz ovos, e a gananciosa proprietária exige às suas galinhas uma boa quota diária de produção, ou acabam na panela. Por isso, as galinhas encaram decidiram organizar-se e fugir.

Ok, there is an huge temptation to riddle this review with puns - but I'm just going to say it's a cracking little family adventure. It's seemingly based on a whole range of classic movies from the "Great Escape", "Star Trek" to "Love Story" with a score cannibalised from just about any/everything ever written by Messrs.

A very good stop-motion animation! 'Chicken Run' , which I watched a crap tonne when I was little but not for a vast number of years now, is an impressive production given it came out in 2000. Despite a pretty simple feel to the film, it's a very well developed concept. The, admittedly short, run time truly flies by.
